description: EXISTING-CHANGE DELIVERY: no implementation step; the head is pinned at start. Reviews, verifies, and delivers a change that already exists as an open same-repository pull request at an exact Git commit, without claiming that this run implemented it. workflow start requires --source-head <40-hex commit> equal to the clean checkout HEAD; the commit is persisted in the run and every gate re-checks it, so a new head needs a new run. There is no execute step and no in-run repair: a failing claim routes back to verify (at most three route-backs; a fourth failing visit blocks), and a code fix is a new head that needs a new run. pr-open adopts the existing pull request through publish-change execute, an authenticated provider observation at the pinned head; it never opens one. merge-ready-ci records CI readiness at the pinned head (provisional delivery is refused) and learn records learning. After completion, workflow publish-delivery seals the checkpoint at the pinned head, its delivery files are pushed to the pull request branch as exactly one delivery-only commit, and merge-change merges that terminal head.

expects.description: A ready work item is selected with scope and acceptance context.

The change under review already existed before this run: its provider record (for example the pull request URL), base, exact head commit, and changed files are recorded in <slug>--existing-change.md. This run makes no implementation claim.
A distinct reviewer recorded a current clean critique of the delivered change.
The selected Work Item acceptance criteria have verified evidence.
Relevant tests or checks have evidence tied to the implemented change.
Policy compliance evidence is attached when policy gates apply.
expects.explore_hint: Use as advisory evidence for scope, security, privacy, release, or repository policy checks.
